snippet.title: Backrooms: Steal the Furniture – Gameplay Trailer (4-player co-op horror)
snippet.description:
Backrooms: Steal the Furniture is a 4-player co-op horror game. Drive your van into the Backrooms, steal furniture for cash, gamble the crew's money in the lobby casino, and try not to be the loudest one when the Faceless is listening.

Unscripted footage from real sessions with friends.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5313000
Coming soon – Mare Holding Oy, Finland
